text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I feel it! A powerful sense of affinity draws me toward the fated NHK Mile Championship! I just know I'm going to crush it today!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: This race is the prelude to my world debut. Just sit back and watch me run fabulously!
